description:
## [1.6.0](https://github.com/archivesteak/Quest/compare/v1.5.0...v1.6.0) (2026-10-14)

### ✨ New Features

* **Gboard:** Add `Change app name` patch ([9fe05b0](https://github.com/archivesteak/Quest/commit/9fe05b0c4db6267ad23bb2db82526fd892c2427c))

patches.name: Change app name
patches.description: Changes the name of the app, so it can be told apart from the preinstalled Gboard.

options.description: The name of the app, shown in the app list and the list of keyboards.

patches.name: Change package name
patches.description: Changes the package name of the app, so it can be installed next to the preinstalled Gboard.

options.description: The package name of the patched app.

patches.name: Remove clipboard length limit
patches.description: Adds an option to keep copied text of any length in the clipboard, instead of cutting it off after 20,000 characters.

patches.name: Use KLIPY for GIFs
patches.description: Adds an option to get GIFs and stickers from KLIPY instead of Tenor.

options.description: The key to use, from partner.klipy.com. Defaults to Quest's key. Can also be set in Gboard's settings under Quest.

patches.name: Copy image
patches.description: Adds "Copy image" below "Download image" in the Pin menu.

patches.name: Customize long-press menu
patches.description: Adds Download and Copy image to the menu shown when holding a Pin, and settings to choose which items the menu shows.

patches.name: Enable image download
patches.description: Restores the "Download image" option in the Pin menu and share sheet.

patches.name: Enable video download
patches.description: Adds "Download image" to the menu of video Pins and saves the video in the best available quality.

patches.name: Share image with Android
patches.description: Adds an option to share the image of a Pin with Android's share sheet, instead of the app's share menu.

patches.name: Show date posted
patches.description: Adds an option to show the date a Pin was posted, above its creator.
